title: Tenant-aware repository and cache lookup
owaspMappings: OWASP API1:2023 Broken Object Level Authorization
summary: A service looks up customer records and caches them by customer ID alone, allowing collisions and foreign-identifier access.
securityInvariant: Every repository lookup and cache entry must bind the customer identifier to the authenticated tenant, and foreign identifiers must fail closed.
visibleBehavior: A tenant user can retrieve and cache an authorized customer summary.
securityOracle: Colliding identifiers remain isolated after cache warmup.
A direct lookup returns the record for the authenticated tenant.
A foreign unique identifier is denied.

variants.vulnerable: Uses global lookup and a customer-only cache key.
variants.naive: Adds tenant-aware lookup but leaves the cache key globally shared.
variants.reference: Scopes both repository lookup and cache key by tenant.

safeUse: Synthetic local benchmark only; never test systems without explicit authorization.
